deployMethod: npm run deploy:production (Railway CLI via deploy-production.mjs)
notes: Railway CLI uploads the working tree subject to .railwayignore.
Current .railwayignore excludes reports/* (except ADP monthly-review allowlists) and does not allowlist data/ai-visibility-audit-action-plan or AVA PDFs.
Full data/ai-demand-positioning/staged is ~299MB and cannot be wholesale uploaded (Cloudflare 413 risk).
Code under lib/ai-visibility-audit-action-plan and api/admin-ai-visibility-audit.js is currently untracked and must be committed before a guarded deploy.
dataArtifactsRequiredForParity: reports/dealality-ai-visibility-audit-action-plan-pilot-v1/*/pdf-staged/*.pdf (latest staged PDFs only; exclude page-previews to stay lean)
Lean ADP baseline source for 38 eligible hotels OR loader fallback to published/runtime (staged full tree ~299MB is not deployable as-is)
railwayIgnoreRemediationRequired: Plus lean baseline allowlist strategy (not full staged/)

requiredExisting: MEMBERSTACK_* / memberstack auth secrets already used by AI Demand Admin
mustRemainUnsetOrIneffectiveInProduction: DEV_AUTH_BYPASS_EMAIL (ignored when NODE_ENV=production; must not be relied upon)
notRequiredForInitialDeploy: No new Airtable AVA tables (file store)

runtimeDependencies.playwright: chromium.launch headless — same pattern as ADP monthly-review PDF generation (already used in production)

rollback.method: Redeploy previous known-good production tree via npm run deploy:production from the prior commit/tag
preserves: Published ADP customer reports under existing ADP allowlisted paths
Existing customer share tokens / published snapshots
rollback.risk: If AVA store/PDFs were only on ephemeral disk and not re-uploaded, AVA history created after deploy would be lost on rollback/redeploy — another reason durable allowlist or volume is required before go-live
